lifecycle.retention: Retain editable logical subject and pinned provenance; product implementation/acceptance are separate records.

body.value:
Большие таблицы NGFP не помещать в Activity Bundle. `lisa_cascade_pin` — SHA-256
ссылка на атомарный snapshot внутри owning layer/form_dependencies; проверять
хеш при восстановлении. Отсутствие/повреждение файла блокирует Save, сохраняя
pin и прежние управляемые значения в durable draft. Не удалять старые snapshots
при обновлении формы: они могут принадлежать незавершённому черновику.

review.value: Keep large tables out of Bundle, exact SHA snapshot/owning-layer pin, hash-checked fail-closed recovery and retained historical draft values/snapshots.

authority_limit.value: Path applicability is reviewed separately from the rule's textual triggers. Every source condition and heading remains attached; no automatic predicate or lifecycle inference. Stored commands and dates do not grant current execution, freshness or product acceptance. Existing instruction clients/checkers remain effective until measured cutover.
